clock.raw: seconds since the boot shot began (the Genesis video plays raw 0 -> 21.6; the live title takes over at raw 21.6)
clock.base: base = raw for raw <= 7.4; base = 7.4 for 7.4 < raw < 10.0 (the origin-shot freeze); base = raw - 2.6 after (title.js:30-32). Every title formula below is on BASE time unless it says raw.

conventions.size: a sprite is drawn at its texture size / ppu x 100 from rect.xy (textures are padded to a multiple of 4 on the right / bottom with transparent px; rect w / h in the manifest include that pad)
conventions.blend: 'over' = straight alpha over (Unity UI/Default); 'add' = additive ('lighter' on the page: UI additive material / premultiplied One-One)
conventions.rect: [x, y, w, h] stage px, top-left origin (layout_land / layout_port convention); ppu 100 = 1 texel per stage px, 200 = 2x
conventions.carries: a layer exported at its page alpha carries that alpha in its pixels: Unity alpha = formula / carries
conventions.files: Resources.Load paths (no extension); localOr = MenuV6Art.LocalOr(local, fallback)

draw: A: rect origin + drawWH, alpha a (over)
emiB: additive, alpha a min(1, ek), ek = clamp(eye, 0, 2); a second pass at a (ek - 1) when ek > 1
SPR.blue (WRLDZ/MenuV6/Rigs/Common/spr_blue) at eyeC, size wpx .7, additive alpha .22 ek a
glint: sheet books.glint frame floor(gl 72) while 0 <= gl < 1, additive, alpha 1 (the gradient alpha .55 sin(gl pi) a is in the pixels)
irisG > 0: SPR.white at iris + (2, -1), size 12, additive alpha .95 irisG a
B is never drawn (the title passes no flick); hot (seam point) is not used

puzzle_settle.rule: raw 21.6 + j / 60: frame j (j = floor((raw - 21.6) 60), 0..35), additive, alpha 1; nothing from raw 22.2
